brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.

requirements.evidence: Four bases (piece:0,0,0 to piece:3,0,0), each with a hex-bin-third-drain bin filled with soil and planted (prop:1-4).

requirements.requirement: A water pipe running through the bases
requirements.evidence: run:run-1 is in irrigation mode and runs straight through all four bases at level 0. It enters at (0,0) from the west side, which is left open as the inlet.

The run passes under the bin in every one of the four cells. The configurator only models the pipe's route. It doesn't model water reaching the soil, how evenly water spreads, or whether the joints seal, so delivery and watertightness depend on your plumbing and printing material. I can't show them as met. A pipe through a cell leaves room only for third-depth bins, so the soil is shallow (about 37 mm trays).

finish.summary: I built a four-cell planter: four full bases in a straight row from (0,0) to (3,0). One straight irrigation pipe run (run:run-1) goes through all four bases. A pipe through a cell leaves room only for a third-depth tray, so each cell holds a third-depth drained bin. The bins are filled with soil and planted, one seedling each. Capping the open faces put solid end caps on the sides, and the far end of the pipe at (3,0) is capped too. The inlet is still open on the west face of (0,0). Joint bolts lock the four bases together. check_build passes with no rule issues, the mesh check is clear and there are no prop warnings. 29 parts, about 1813 g of filament.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: 1 run IRRIGATION: non-potable supply. Corners are flexible hose, glued into Sch 40 sockets, one coupling wherever hose meets rigid pipe.

Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
